name: Vasili III of Russia
role: Grand Prince of Moscow from 1505 to 1533
contribution: Grand Prince of Moscow and all Russia from 1505 until his death in 1533.
legacy: Following on the ambitions of his father, this person annexed Pskov and Ryazan – the last remaining autonomous Russian territories – and captured the city of Smolensk from Lithuania

checks.lead: Vasili III Ivanovich (Russian: Василий III Иванович; Christian name: Gavriil; monastic name: Varlaam; 25 March 1479 – 3 December 1533) was Grand Prince of Moscow and all Russia from 1505 until his death in 1533.
